name: Sumble
description:
Research any company directly from Claude. See what technologies an organization uses, who works there, and what roles they're hiring for. Explore team structures, reporting lines, and active initiatives inside your target accounts.

Find decision-makers by job function and seniority. Enrich contacts with email addresses. Track hiring signals from job postings. Build and manage account and contact lists without leaving your conversation.

Sumble turning hours of manual account research into a single query.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sumble to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sumble to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.sumble.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sumble MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sumble lists 23 MCP tools, including GetAccountInformation, GetMyCompanyProfile, LogOut, SearchTechnologies, FindOrganizations, EnrichOrganization, MatchOrganizations, ListOrganizationLists, GetOrganizationList, CreateOrganizationList, AddOrganizationsToList, and ListContactLists.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sumble?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Sumble in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Sumble requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sumble is developed by Sumble, Inc. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
